response.overview: While being intimate with Julien, Roberto is startled by something he sees in the mirror-something, or someone, that is not his boyfriend. Julien dismisses the vision as a hallucination, until they come face-to-face with a strange being in the kitchen. This otherworldly presence has crossed through the mirror to deliver a message to Roberto: his relationship is not what he thinks it is, and it's time to confront reality, desire, and emotional truth. But before moving on, Roberto is given one final opportunity to experience what he once had. Relationships are often described as a two-way street, but they can also contain layers shaped by fear, self-doubt, and internal conflict. Is Roberto ready to confront his fears and face the truth reflected in the mirror one last time?
response.title: The Mirror
